subject: Mythology
title: Kali: The Dark Mother
description: A micro-lesson that makes Kali: The Dark Mother usable.

hook.text: Kali burst from Durga's forehead as pure rage, a black-skinned goddess wearing a necklace of severed heads.

buildup.text: She was unleashed to destroy demons that regenerated from every drop of their own blood spilled in battle.

discovery.text: Kali drank the demons' blood before it could touch the ground, preventing them from multiplying.

twist.text: Drunk on battle, she danced so wildly that the earth shook. Only Shiva lying at her feet stopped her destruction.

climax.text: Kali represents the ultimate divine feminine: creation, protection, and destruction wrapped in fearsome beauty.

punchline.text: The most terrifying goddess is also the most protective mother.

quiz.question: How did Kali stop the demons from regenerating?
options: She sealed them in an enchanted prison
She drank their blood before it touched the ground
She burned them with divine fire
